Iodine deﬁciency disorders
Iodine deﬁciency has multiple adverse effects on growth and development in animals and humans (Zimmermann, 2009). These are
collectively termed the iodine deﬁciency disorders (IDD) (Table 1), and are one of the most important and common human
diseases. They result from inadequate thyroid hormone production due to lack of sufﬁcient iodine.

Thyroid enlargement (goiter) is the classic sign of iodine deﬁciency. It is a physiologic adaptation to chronic iodine deﬁciency.
